## Point this at it

Run [Beta Signal](beta-signal.html) once against the module that last
changed. See also [the atlas](atlas.html).

## Reading it

- Red: the signal moved.
- Green: it did not.
- Neither proves the late effects are absent.

## If the doubt survives

The remaining doubt is late effects, which nothing here closes.
